steps.content: As arranged, someone will pick Milly up at the DisCity port.
She carefully takes the document bearing Chief's signature from an inner pocket, and reads it over and over.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...Wait for me. We'll see each other again soon.
Helicopters and aircraft occasionally pass overhead. Some fly close to the ground, emitting deafening roars.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: There you are! Finally found you.

Milly turns her head to see a girl in a flight jacket pelting toward her like an aircraft in a nosedive. The Bureau's logo is emblazoned on her clothes, and her striking orange hair is impossible to miss.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Hey, Milly! I'm Zephyr. Great to meet you!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Where do you wanna go? How about a bar? I know all the best spots in Eastside. Or we can catch a movie? Or... are you hungry? We can grab a bite. Nobody knows the food scene in Eastside better than I do.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Um... I'm not really here for fun. You can just take me to MBCC!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: We'll get there, of course. But come on, you have no idea the hoops I had to jump through just to get this assignment and stretch my legs. Can't we just get back a little later? Staying cooped up in the Bureau all day... might as well bury me alive.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh, is it like that? On my way here, I got the impression that everyone at MBCC was really friendly and open-minded.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You'll see how dreary it is once you get in. Sure, there's the parole policy, but at the end of the day, we're still inmates. We just get a tiny bit of freedom back, that's all.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hmm... I don't need to go anywhere else. As long as I'm in the Bureau, I can be with Chief all the time.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Just being able to see Chief every day... that's all the happiness I need.
Zephyr stares at her like she's an alien.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Jeez. They told me I was picking someone up from Euphoria, but they never mentioned the place was a breeding ground for lovesick puppies... Being stuck with the same person, in the same place, every single day? Wouldn't you die of boredom?
Seeing the blank look on Milly's face, Zephyr sighs and softens her tone.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Look, think about it. If you're with someone day in and day out, what would you even talk about?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: That wouldn't be a problem. Just looking at that person is enough to make me happy.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Stop. Okay, I get it. Give me a sec.
Zephyr ponders for a couple of seconds, then gets an idea.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Alright! I'll take you to some new places. Chief is no fun, all work and no play. If you're just trailing after him 24/7, what would you have to talk about? But if you go out, have some fun on your own, see some cool stuff... then you'll never run out of things to share with him.
steps.female_content: Alright! I'll take you to some new places. Chief is no fun, all work and no play. If you're just trailing after her 24/7, what would you have to talk about? But if you go out, have some fun on your own, see some cool stuff... then you'll never run out of things to share with her.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hey! Chief is the best! The kindest, most wonderful person I know!
Before Milly can protest further, Zephyr hooks her arm and begins dragging her into the city.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Fine, fine, whatever you say. Well then, let's go. Think of it this way: you're having fun for Chief's sake. If you care for Chief and want to make him happy, you've got to be happy first. That way, you can share your joy with him.
steps.female_content: Fine, fine, whatever you say. Well then, let's go. Think of it this way: you're having fun for Chief's sake. If you care for Chief and want to make her happy, you've got to be happy first. That way, you can share your joy with her.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Come on, let's grab something to eat first. I just found this amazing pastry. You're going to love it.
[Cafe]
Zephyr pulls Milly through the streets of Eastside and into a small shop.

steps.speaker: Shop Owner
steps.content: Hello, Zephyr! The usual? Melon buns?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You know it! Make it three!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Is someone else joining us?

steps.speaker: Shop Owner
steps.content: Zephyr usually has two. She has to load up before long flight missions. Can't take off on an empty stomach.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: So you really are a pilot...

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Hehe, how about that? Wanna go for a ride?
Milly freezes for a second before breaking into a smile. It's an almost instinctual reaction to fear—a perfect, gorgeous smile, like a flawless mask.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You'd take me flying?
Zephyr glances at Milly and purses her lips. Then she brushes her hair back and laughs.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Yeah, I would. But only when you really want to. When you're not afraid anymore.
Zephyr grabs a menu from the counter.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Gonna borrow this.

The owner, seemingly used to this, smiles and disappears into the kitchen. A moment later, she returns with a tray of piping hot melon buns. The crust is a beautiful golden brown, and the air is filled with the faint, sweet scent of melon.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: There's no other place in all of DisCity that bakes with real, fresh melon. They say this is what melons tasted like before the Nightfall. You can't get this flavor anywhere else.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: How did you find out about this place?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Well...

steps.speaker: Shop Owner
steps.content: The recipe was my mother's. Zephyr and I met at the amusement park. I passed out from fear on the drop tower ride, and she was the one who brought me back.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Drop tower?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Oh? Interested? We can go later. It feels... just like a plane crash.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: A... a plane crash?
Milly stares, and Zephyr wiggles her fingers to mimic an airplane. Something flutters from her hand.
Milly flinches back before realizing it's a paperplane, freshly folded from the menu.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: A plane crash. It's simple. Your heart pounds for a bit. You feel weightless, like you're floating for a good long while... and then it's over.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Like... falling in love?
Zephyr bursts out laughing.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You're really something else, you know? I'm starting to like you more and more.
She grabs a knife and cuts into one of the buns. The golden crust cracks open, revealing an oozing, bright green melon filling. Zephyr presses a small fork into Milly's hand.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Try it.
Milly puts a piece in her mouth.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's... it's so delicious...
It's a flavor she's never known. Rich and sweet, but with a surprising freshness. The soft, fluffy texture and the lingering heat from the oven warm her from the inside out.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: See? I bet even Chief hasn't tried this yet. Next time, you can tell him you know a place that sells melon from before the Nightfall, and then, you'll get yourselves a sweet little date.
steps.female_content: See? I bet even Chief hasn't tried this yet. Next time, you can tell her you know a place that sells melon from before the Nightfall, and then, you'll get yourselves a sweet little date.

steps.content: Milly's face goes a little red.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's... so warm. I thought only love could feel this warm... Thank you, Zephyr. I'll definitely bring Chief here next time.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: ...Oh. Well, that's great. See? I told you you'd love it. Okay, let's go to the cinema next. Then there's the amusement park, the bars... we've got tons of things to do!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Okay!
[Bar]

Several hours later. A thunderous crash echoes through the Sky Bar in Eastside. A tower of a man topples from his chair, dead drunk, while the blonde girl, his drinking opponent, takes a long sip from another Tequila Sunrise.
The crowd erupts into cheers and applause.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.content: Miss Milly wins! Mr. Jequin will be picking up the tabs for Milly and Zephyr! Ladies and gentlemen, looks like we've crowned our new Golden Goblet Queen. Let's give it up for... Milly!
The cheers grow louder as Milly's cheeks flush under the lights.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Milly, you're unbelievable! Was that your 23rd drink?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: So, I won our bet! Now can you tell me how you won that paperplane contest?

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Ah, but a pilot never reveals her trade secrets!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Then let's have a rematch!

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: You're on.

The crowd cheers as they both launch their planes. Milly's veers off course, nosediving into a partition near the bar. Zephyr's sails cleanly over the grooving crowd and disappears into the neon lights outside.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I'll go see where it landed.
She hops off her stool. The alcohol makes her a little unsteady, but her steps are light as she heads for the door.
The music grows sensual as the lights paint the dance floor red and purple. The joyful crowd dances to the rhythm, waving and whistling pleasantly to Milly, their Golden Goblet Queen.
Milly smiles.

This kind of attention feels different from what she's used to on Euphoria. There's no love or lust in their eyes, only simple joy and ease. She feels light, like a deer bounding through the woods, freed from a suffocating shell.
[Rooftop]

Milly finds herself on the rooftop terrace, but the paperplane is nowhere in sight. She leans over the glass railing and peers down. In the pale light of dawn, even Eastside, the city that never sleeps, begins to dim its lights.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Ahhh...
She takes a deep breath of DisCity's morning air, so different from the scorching heat of WhiteSands. The cool breeze seems to calm her racing heart.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Milly, what are you doing out here?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hmm? Looking for your plane, of course.
She holds it up.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It flew so far! I want to keep it... as a memento of tonight.
More lights go out across the city as the sky brightens.

This is the tallest building in Eastside. From here, they can see all the way to the horizon, where the clouds begin to blush red as a crimson sun slowly rises from the darkness. Long shadows retreat across the land, like great phantom ships sinking into the sea.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: That was a magical night. Thank you for everything.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I think... I'm starting to get it. What Kawa-kawa, you, and even Chief have been trying to tell me.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: On this trip, I've seen so many things I'd never seen before... or things I'd seen but never really noticed.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I like the stars, and the sunrise. I like the movies, the bars, and paperplanes. I like DisCity, and the people who live here.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I'll cherish all these happy moments. I'll always hold them dear to my heart.
She turns to Zephyr, smiling.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But "like" isn't the same as "love." I can like lots and lots of things. But there's only one person I love.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: He's the one I can't get out of my head, the one who makes me restless. Just one glance from him is enough to make me giddy with joy. And if I had to, I'd gladly give my life for him.
steps.female_content: She's the one I can't get out of my head, the one who makes me restless. Just one glance from her is enough to make me giddy with joy. And if I had to, I'd gladly give my life for her.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Milly...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But now I know this isn't something that can be rushed. Since Chief arranged this trip for me, it probably means he isn't ready either.
steps.female_content: But now I know this isn't something that can be rushed. Since Chief arranged this trip for me, it probably means she isn't ready either.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: If I kept trying to force my feelings on him, it would be just hollow, wishful thinking that would only make things awkward for him.
steps.female_content: If I kept trying to force my feelings on her, it would be just hollow, wishful thinking that would only make things awkward for her.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: So, it's time I change my approach.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I'm going to see more of the world, explore new things, and meet all kinds of wonderful people. I'll gather all these amazing stories and let them become a part of me. Then, when the time is right, I'll share them with Chief. We can even go see them together.
steps.female_content: I'm going to see more of the world, explore new things, and meet all kinds of wonderful people. I'll gather all these amazing stories, and let them become a part of me. Then, when the time is right, I'll share them with Chief. We can even go see them together.

steps.speaker: Zephyr
steps.content: Phew... I'm glad you figured things out. Man, I gotta say, I'm starting to get a little jealous of Chief.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't worry, Zephyr. You're amazing. You'll find your true love. I'm sure of it!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's such a big, wide world. Somewhere out there, there's got to be someone you love, who loves you back.
The sun rises behind her, bathing her hair in a radiant halo of light.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I'm ready to see Chief now. Please, take me to MBCC.
